subject: Security onboarding: SIG prefill + legal touchpoints
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia@finovatehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security onboarding: SIG prefill + legal touchpoints

Hi Lydia — thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and next steps from my side so we keep momentum on the compliance path we discussed.

Call recap (high level):
- Goal: Validate hosting/residency, SOC 2 status, and start a SIG prefills + a short custom questionnaire so your security team can triage quickly.
- Hosting: Finovate indicated EU data residency requirement for PII; also a small US footprint for analytics.
- Compliance: You mentioned SOC 2 Type II undergoing final audit (expected Q3), and HIPAA considerations for PHI flows — you flagged a BAA will be required.

As a next step I can:
1) Send a prefilled SIG spreadsheet (we will mark fields as "redacted/see SOC2 report" where appropriate) so your team can jumpstart their review.
2) Attach a short 6-question custom form (fewer false-positives for product questions we know matter).
3) Share a redacted SOC 2 Type II sample and our DPA/BAA draft so your legal can start parallel review.

Clarifying asks for your security/legal teams (short bullets — helps prioritize):
- Preferred questionnaire: SIG (standard) OR CAIQ (cloud-specific) OR SIG + 6-Q custom? Please confirm.
- Redaction policy: do you accept a SOC 2 with sensitive fields redacted, or do you need the full report under an NDA?
- SSO/provisioning: SAML or OIDC preferred?
- Data flow: confirm which environments (prod EU, backup US) will see customer data.
- Timeline: ideal date to complete initial review?

I will attach the prefill and a draft DPA for your review. If it helps we can set a 30-minute follow-up next week with Kimberly (SE) and Markus (legal) on our side to walk any narrow technical/legal asks.

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_Prefill_v1.xlsx (prefill), Redwood_DPA_Draft.docx (draft DPA)

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
From: Lydia Park <lydia@finovatehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Security onboarding: SIG prefill + legal touchpoints

Marcus — thanks for the summary and for taking notes. Confirmation and a couple answers here:

- Preferred: SIG prefill + your short custom questions (our SecOps prefers the SIG canonical format but likes a tiny addendum of product-specific items).
- SOC2: we can accept a redacted SOC 2 for initial triage; full report can be provided under an NDA if needed. Final audit expected mid-August.
- BAA: yes, we will require a BAA (HIPAA-covered product).
- SSO: SAML is our standard for enterprise customers.
- Data residency: primary production EU (Frankfurt), backups in US-East.
- Timeline: we'd like initial review complete by 2026-07-02 if possible.

I'll introduce our security lead on the follow-up thread (security@finovatehealth.com) if that's OK. We are available for a 30-minute call next Thursday 2026-06-17 between 09:00–11:00 ET.

Thanks,
Lydia Park
Head of Partnerships | Finovate Health
lydia@finovatehealth.com

Action items I will take this morning:

- Share a redacted SOC 2 sample (attached: Redacted_SOC2_TypeII_sample.pdf).
- Drop our DPA/BAA draft for legal review (attached: Redwood_DPA_Draft.docx).

Thanks Marcus — that plan looks good. Confirming: 2026-06-17 10:00 ET works for the call.

One small note for the prefill: please call out whether token-level logs are retained and for how long (we need retention windows for our ingestion pipelines). Also include whether you offer per-tenant encryption keys/KMS integration — our security team will likely ask about a bring-your-own-key option.

I've CC'd our InfoSec (security@finovatehealth.com) who will review the prefill and SOC redaction policy. They prefer SAML metadata exchange ahead of the call.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — speak next week.

Best,
Lydia
